source: Hand-curated per-country fields for scripts/build-nations.ts. capital/iso2/region: common knowledge (ISO 3166-1, UN M49 regions). activePersonnel: IISS Military Balance 2024-2026 as reproduced in Wikipedia 'List of countries by number of military and paramilitary personnel' (read 2026-11-02); figures marked in estimatedFields are not IISS. nuclearWarheads: FAS 'Status of World Nuclear Forces' 2026 (total inventory, early 2026). defenceSpendUsdBn overrides: SIPRI 'Trends in World Military Expenditure, 2024' fact sheet (Apr 2025) for Taiwan; all others are regional approximations marked estimate (SIPRI/World Bank have no figure). Economic overrides: Bank of Korea (North Korea, 2024), ONEI/ECLAC (Cuba), World Bank (Syria 2024, Monaco 2024), UN National Accounts (Eritrea 2024), IMF/World Bank DSA (Somalia 2025), Trading Economics/IMF via Wikipedia (Venezuela, Yemen debt). blocs: NATO, EU, CSTO, SCO, BRICS, GCC, AUKUS, Quad official membership as of 2026-11-02 (Saudi Arabia excluded from BRICS: invited 2024, has not confirmed accession per Reuters, Sept 2026; Armenia kept in CSTO: participation frozen since 2024 but no formal withdrawal). resources: globally significant producers only, from USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2025, EIA, FAO and UNCTAD Review of Maritime Transport (editorial selection, max 5).
notes: Entries with estimatedFields are approximations, not sourced figures. activePersonnel 0 = no standing armed forces. Overrides in 'overrides' replace the IMF/World Bank value for that field.

nations.name: Cuba
nations.notes: IMF has no Cuba data. GDP: secondary 2024 estimate at market rates (official ONEI figure uses a 1:24 rate). Growth: ONEI 2024 (-1.1%). Debt: no official figure; approximation.

nations.name: Venezuela
nations.notes: SIPRI publishes no reliable recent figure; IMF publishes no debt ratio. Debt approximation follows Trading Economics 2024 (164%).

nations.name: Monaco
nations.notes: IMF has no Monaco data. GDP and growth: World Bank WDI 2024 (IMSEE). Monaco carries no sovereign debt; 0 is an approximation.

nations.name: Armenia
nations.notes: CSTO participation frozen since 2024; no formal withdrawal as of 2026-11-02 (summit 2026-11-11 may change this).

nations.name: Palestine
nations.notes: IMF code WBG (West Bank and Gaza). PA security forces ~30,000 (Oslo II ceiling / public estimates); security sector roughly a fifth of the PA budget. Not covered by IISS/SIPRI.

nations.name: Qatar
nations.notes: SIPRI publishes no Qatar figure after 2010; approximation from the published 2024 state budget defence line.

nations.name: Saudi Arabia
nations.notes: Invited to BRICS from 2024-01-01; accession not confirmed by Riyadh as of Sept 2026, so not listed.

nations.name: Syria
nations.notes: IMF has no Syria data since 2010. GDP and growth: World Bank 2024 assessment. New army strength ~170-180k (open-source; no IISS count). Debt: approximation (external debt to Iran/Russia unknown).

nations.name: United Arab Emirates
nations.notes: SIPRI publishes no UAE figure after 2014; approximation consistent with IISS Military Balance estimates (~$22-25bn).

nations.name: Yemen
nations.notes: Seat of the recognised government is Aden; Sanaa is the constitutional capital. IMF publishes no recent debt ratio; 71% follows the IMF estimate reproduced by Wikipedia (2025).

nations.name: Libya
nations.notes: Divided state. ~32,000 under the Tripoli government (open-source estimate; LNA in the east ~90,000 not counted). SIPRI has no post-2014 figure.

nations.name: Sudan
nations.notes: Civil war since 2023; SIPRI has no recent figure.

nations.name: DR Congo
nations.notes: Cobalt/coltan grouped under rareEarths as strategic battery minerals.

nations.name: Eritrea
nations.notes: IMF publishes no Eritrea data after 2019. GDP: UN National Accounts 2024 (US$1,917m). Growth: AfDB-style approximation. Debt: IMF last figure (2019) was 260% and falling; 180% is an approximation.

nations.name: Somalia
nations.notes: IMF WEO publishes no debt ratio; 8.6% of GDP (2025) from the joint IMF-World Bank Debt Sustainability Analysis after HIPC completion.

nations.name: Turkmenistan
nations.notes: SIPRI publishes no Turkmenistan figure.

nations.name: Uzbekistan
nations.notes: SIPRI publishes no Uzbekistan figure.

nations.name: Afghanistan
nations.notes: SIPRI has no figure for the Taliban government.

nations.name: North Korea
nations.notes: IMF has no DPRK data. GDP: Bank of Korea 2024 nominal GNI (44.4 trn KRW, ~US$32bn) used as GDP proxy. Growth: Bank of Korea 2024 (+3.7%). Defence ~4bn and debt ~15% are approximations (US State Dept WMEAT-style estimates; defaulted external debt ~US$5bn).

nations.name: Taiwan
nations.notes: IMF lists Taiwan as TWN ('Taiwan Province of China'). World Bank has no Taiwan rows; defence figure from SIPRI fact sheet Apr 2025 (2024 data), population from IMF.

nations.name: Indonesia
nations.notes: Nickel (largest producer) is not in the resource vocabulary.

nations.name: Laos
nations.notes: SIPRI publishes no Laos figure. SCO dialogue partner since 2026, not a member.
